home.adminDescription: Every hotel on the platform at a glance.
home.name: Name
home.emptyBody: Put your QR code at the front desk or on the tables, and guests will show up here.
home.captureBody: Guests open it from your QR code. You can also send it to them.
home.noHotelsBody: Create the first hotel and invite its owner. They will see their guests here.
home.noAccessTitle: You are not part of a hotel yet
home.noAccessBody: Ask your hotel manager to invite you. The invitation arrives by email, open it to join.

auth.brandTitle: Know your guests. Welcome them back.
auth.brandBody: Collect guest details with their consent, remember what they like and bring them back to your hotel.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Pick something you do not use anywhere else.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.invalid: A reset link works once and for one hour. Ask for a new one.
reset.done: Password updated. You can sign in now.

errors.exists: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.

invitation.title: Join {hotel}
invitation.wrongAccount: This invitation was sent to another email address. Sign in with that one to accept it.
invitation.invalid: It may have expired or already been used. Ask the hotel for a new one.

errorPages.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped. Let us get you back.
errorPages.errorBody: It is on our side. Try again, and if it keeps happening let us know.

guestData.title: Guest data
guestData.description: Export or delete what you store about your guests. Owners and managers only.
guestData.forbidden: Only owners and managers can export or delete guest data.
guestData.hotelDescription: A copy of every guest of the hotel with their consent log, or a full deletion.
guestData.deleteAllBody: This permanently deletes {count} guests of {hotel} with their consent history. It cannot be undone. Export first if you need a copy.
guestData.guestDescription: Find a guest by name, phone or email.
guestData.deleteGuestBody: This permanently deletes {name} and their consent history. It cannot be undone.

unsubscribe.title: Your messages from {hotel}
unsubscribe.intro: Choose what {hotel} may send you. You can change this at any time.
unsubscribe.stopped: {hotel} will not send you any more messages.
unsubscribe.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
unsubscribe.invalid: The link is wrong or no longer active. If you keep getting messages, reply STOP to the message.

legal.updated: Draft, not yet reviewed by a lawyer.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This is a placeholder for the privacy policy of le-hoetel. Hotels collect a guest's name, phone and language with their consent. Optional details are kept only if the guest agrees. We never collect continuous location, ID numbers or payment cards. A guest can ask a hotel to export or delete their data at any time.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: This is a placeholder for the terms of service of le-hoetel. The text will be written for the product, the hotels and the law of Tunisia before the first pilot.
